name: Hotel Casa da Calçada Relais & Chateaux
insider_take: Nestled in the heart of Amarante, a town that time has lovingly preserved, Casa da Calçada is a 16th-century manor house that transforms a stay in northern Portugal into something truly aristocratic — refined, intimate, and utterly unforgettable.
whats_special: A palatial 16th-century manor set within walled gardens overlooking the serene Rio Tâmega river and the iconic São Gonçalo Bridge. Home to Largo do Paço , one of Portugal's most celebrated Michelin-starred restaurants, helmed by chef Tiago Bonito — a true pilgrimage for food lovers. Part of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection, guaranteeing world-class hospitality with deeply local soul. Just steps from the 12th-century Monastery of São Gonçalo , patron saint of marriage — making it a dream destination for romantic getaways and weddings.
pro_tip: Book a table at Largo do Paço well in advance — the tasting menu paired with Portuguese wines from their exceptional cellar is an experience that rivals any dining room in Iberia. Ask for a window seat overlooking the river at sunset.
dont_miss: Amarante's Festa de São Gonçalo — held in June, this vibrant festival fills the streets with music, processions, and the famous phallic-shaped "bolos de São Gonçalo" pastries, a cheeky local tradition. A stroll across the São Gonçalo Bridge for postcard-perfect views of the manor's façade reflected in the Tâmega river. Exploring the Douro Wine Region , just a short scenic drive away — the hotel team can arrange private vineyard tours and tastings.
pros: Historic 16th-century manor house with authentic Portuguese architecture
Riverside location along the scenic Tâmega River
Michelin-starred Largo do Paço restaurant with exceptional cuisine
Relais & Châteaux luxury standards and personalized service
cons: Small town location with limited nightlife options
Historic building constraints may limit modern amenities
